title: $lookup 73211009 Diabetes mellitus with property=*
exercises: $lookup with property=* on a concept with many children and relationships
why: Fast: one concept, but every fact and designation is serialised.

expectedDifferences.reason: our $lookup adds sufficientlyDefined (a SNOMED CT on FHIR property, from definitionStatusId), which tx.fhir.org does not report; and it leaves out defining relationships whose rows are inactive (363698007 = 127944005, 78696007, 86762007 for 73211009), which tx.fhir.org reports (findings U2: inactive relationship rows are history, not properties).
